dataTransforms.description:
List of data transform types, which will be applied after the data is
received but before saving it in the state.

Constraint: These types must extend {@link UiSdlDataTransform}.

format.description: Specifies the format options of the param kind

valueType.description:
Specifies how to transform the extracted value. The default is string, but depending on the use case
it may be useful to transform the value to a value type like numbers, arrays, etc.

mapState.description: The map to extract values from

key.description: The key to extract from the map

path.description: Additional path context for the extracted item

action.description: An action to evaluate on the extracted value

title: Dynamic value spec that extracts a value from a part of state that is a map
name: MapStateParam
